more_info.overview: Ammonium phosphatides is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include cocoa and chocolate products as covered by directive 2000/36/ec, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use estimates were below the limit.
Animal chronic and developmental studies found no effects at the tested high doses used in the assessment.
